description: Asynchronously record successful file-change hints and intentional research-result receipts.

hooks.command: python -I -B -c "import os,runpy,sys,pathlib;c=[r'${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}',r'${PLUGIN_ROOT}',os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.getcwd()];s=next((pathlib.Path(x)/'scripts'/'record_change.py' for x in c if x and (pathlib.Path(x)/'scripts'/'record_change.py').is_file()),None);runpy.run_path(str(s),run_name='__main__') if s else None"

python -I -B -c "import os,runpy,sys,pathlib;c=[r'${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}',r'${PLUGIN_ROOT}',os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.getcwd()];s=next((pathlib.Path(x)/'scripts'/'record_research_result.py' for x in c if x and (pathlib.Path(x)/'scripts'/'record_research_result.py').is_file()),None);runpy.run_path(str(s),run_name='__main__') if s else None"
